model_annotation: This line chart presents the F1-scores for three different methods (referred to as FLAT, OURS, and UNROADS) over a series of epochs. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 16, with a total of 10 epochs. The y-axis indicates the F1-score, which varies from approximately 0.55 to 0.90 across the epochs. The FLAT method is represented by a blue line with circle markers, the OURS method by a red line with square markers, and the UNROADS method by a yellow line with triangle markers. All three lines show an overall increase in F1-score as the number of epochs increases, with the UNROADS method consistently achieving the highest F1-score and the initial F1-score of the FLAT method being the lowest.
